rationale: Single iROZHLAS data-journalism article on branch/ATM loss — valuable evidence datapoint, not a recurring feed; URL failure is soft, re-resolve from parent.
One-off Aktualne.cz piece documenting the Euronet municipal-subsidy IAD model; cite as evidence, don't monitor.
COOP group site is the best actor-level handle on cash-back at POS, but access unknown and URL unverified — recheck liveness before approving.
Public legal trade outlet with continuous coverage of the right-to-cash legislative track; standalone monitorable feed.
PSP.cz tisky search is a primary, queryable document register; explanatory memoranda carry official cash-usage quantification.
APEK study series is the canonical online payment-mix source but the full study is membership-gated — a human must clear access.
Dedicated APEK data portal with repeatable payment-method indicators; distinct standalone subdomain, worth its own monitor.
Shoptet/Zbozi real-time e-commerce portal — highest-frequency platform-derived acceptance denominators available for CZ.
Shoptet press room publishes recurring platform-wide payment-method/gateway round-ups; a genuine producing feed.
Shoptet Pay product/method pages track which acceptance methods reach the long tail of e-shops; separate domain, low-cost monitor.
GoPay blog is a continuously updated PSP feed carrying method-mix and share claims; vendor bias but useful signal.
Comgate blog/press clippings are the rarest public source of gateway-level QR and A2A method shares in CZ.
Top-3 CZ gateway whose site and interviews disclose merchant counts and processed volume — proxy for online acceptance growth.
PayU CZ country site documents local method availability incl. Twisto BNPL; modest but steady acceptance-layer signal.
Small CZ/SK gateway useful only for cross-border comparison; thin publishing record, revisit if actor map needs depth.
Bank-owned BNPL on the acceptance side; merchant-facing pages track BNPL penetration of CZ baskets.
Most-cited CZ BNPL brand; corporate communications are the main handle on BNPL share of online volume.
Heureka press centre carries the only genuine recurring quarterly CZ e-commerce turnover/AOV time series.
SOCR member surveys uniquely quantify merchant card-acceptance cost and interchange advocacy; ongoing publisher.
Mastercard CZ newsroom carries recurring consumer payment surveys, but URL unverified and it has 7 siblings — confirm the right canonical CZ newsroom path.
Retail trade feed that reliably republishes Heureka/Mastercard/APEK releases — efficient single discovery channel.
Specialist CZ e-commerce media covering gateways, A2A and PSP interviews; good ongoing snowball hub.
Useful e-shop-count denominators but low credibility and unclear access/licensing — verify before relying on it.
Single company data profile for Shoptet; corroboration artifact only, and reachability/terms unconfirmed.
POS vendor is the offline acceptance counterpart, but publishes aggregate card-share data only sporadically — confirm it actually produces signals.
A product page for POS analytics rather than a publishing source; weak standalone value at this stage.
Acquirer gateway product page on csas.cz with 3 siblings — cover via the Ceska sporitelna parent monitor rather than separately.
Commercial gateway comparison round-ups: mine once to complete the CZ acceptance actor map, then archive — low credibility for figures.
